headlines.title: 중동 불안 에 유류세 인하 9월까지 연장 … 석유 최고가격제도 유지

기타.summary: 정부가 미국의 무역법 301조 관세 조치와 국내 디지털 제도를 둘러싼 미국 측 우려에 대응하기 위해 대미... 여 본부장은 방미 기간 빌 해거티 상원의원과 에이드리언 스미스 하원 세입위원회 무역소위원장 등 미국 상...

기타.title: 에너토크, 마키나락스와 손잡고 ‘AI 네이티브 팩토리’ 구축
기타.summary: 전동 액추에이터 전문기업 에너토크가 대한민국 대표 피지컬 AI 기업 마키나락스와 'AI 네이티브 팩토리(AI-Native Factory) 구축을 위한 전략적 협력' 업무협약을 체결했다고 24일 밝혔습니다. 지난 23일 경기 여주에 위치한 에너토크 공장에서 열린 협약식에는 이충열 에너토크 대표와 윤성호 마키나락스 대표가 참석해  협약서에 서명했습니다. 1987년 설립된 에너토크는 발전, 상·하수도, 농업, 제철, 석유화학, 가스 등 다양한 산업 분야에 적용되는 밸브·댐퍼용 전동 액추에이터를 국산화하며 전량 수입에 의존하던 국내 시장을 대체해 온 국내 대표 전동 액추에이터 전문기업입니다. 에너토크는 이번 협약을 계기로 원가..

top5_headlines.title: '꼼수 관세' 꺼낸 트럼프 , 강제노동 관세 60개 국 부과...한국 12.5%
top5_headlines.summary: 도널드 트럼프 미국 행정부가 한국을 포함한 전 세계 60개 교역국을 상대로 최고 12.5%에 달하는 무역법 301조 강제노동 관세를 부과한다. 한국도 사실상 12.5%의 관세를 맞았다. 로이터 통신은 23일(현지시간) 복수의 백악관 고위 당국자를 인용해 오는 24일 0시01분부터 60개 교역국에서 수입되는 물품에 대해 10~12.

top5_headlines.title: 3분기 공적채권 67조원 발행 …" 채권 수요 다소 회복 "
top5_headlines.summary: 재경부, 채권 발행기관 협의체 회의 재정경제부 청사 [촬영 김주성] 정부세종청사 내 재정경제부 청사. 2026.1.6 (세중=연합뉴스) 안채원 기자 = 정부가 3분기 국고채를 제외한 주요 공적채권을 67조원 규모로 발행한다. 정책 수요 증가로 당초 계획보다 4조원 늘어난 규모다.

top5_headlines.title: 美, 韓 '환율관찰대상국' 유지 "원화약세, 경제체력 대비 과도"
top5_headlines.summary: 美 재무부, 환율 보고서 中日 등 10개국 리스트에 올려 달러당 원화값 1460원대 복귀 미국 행정부가 한국을 4회 연속 환율 관찰대상국으로 지정했다. 다만 미국 재무부는 한국 외환당국이 원화 약세를 막기 위해 달러를 순매도한 사실을 인정하며, 최근 원화 약세가 한국 경제의 강한 기초체력에 부합하지 않는다고 평가했다.

top5_headlines.title: 물가 또 꿈틀 … 석유 최고가격 묶고 유류세 인하 연장
top5_headlines.summary: ■ 정부, 국제유가 급등에 대응책 마련 최고가격 4주 동결…추이 따라 조정 휘발유 1784원·경유 1773원 유지 먹거리 수급 안정에 3500억 투입 계란 2.3억개·고등어 3200톤 수입 구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관이 24일 서울 종로구 정부서울청사에서 열린 민생물가 특별관리 관계장관 태스크포스(TF)를 주재하고 있다.

top5_headlines.title: [단독] 월세 가격까지 치솟자…정부, 월세 세액공제 혜택 늘린다
top5_headlines.summary: 서울 강남구 한 부동산 중개업소 [연합뉴스] 부동산 시장에서 월세가격이 지속적으로 오르자 정부가 월세 세액공제 혜택을 더욱 늘리기로 했다. 임차인의 주거비 부담을 일부나마 완화해주기 위해서다. 24일 정부 관계자에 따르면 재정경제부는 8월 초 발표할 예정인 세법개정안에 월세 세액공제 혜택을 확대하는 방안을 담을 계획이다.

key_headlines.title: Trump Administration Imposes 12.5% Forced Labor Tariffs on South Korea
key_headlines.summary: The Trump administration has imposed forced labor tariffs under Trade Law Section 301 on 60 trading countries, with South Korea facing 12.5% tariffs. This replaces the previous 10% global tariffs that expired on July 24.

key_headlines.title: US Maintains South Korea on Currency Surveillance List Despite Recognizing Policy Efforts
key_headlines.summary: The US Treasury Department kept South Korea on its currency surveillance list for the fourth consecutive time, though acknowledging that South Korea's foreign exchange authorities engaged in net dollar sales to prevent won depreciation. The US assessed that recent won weakness is excessive relative to Korea's economic fundamentals.

key_headlines.title: Government Extends Oil Price Controls and Expands Monthly Rent Tax Deductions
key_headlines.summary: The government froze oil price caps and extended fuel tax reductions to combat rising inflation, while planning to expand monthly rent tax deduction benefits in the tax reform bill to be announced in early August. These measures aim to ease living costs amid inflationary pressures.

key_headlines.title: Q3 Government Bond Issuance Increased to 67 Trillion Won Amid Recovering Demand
key_headlines.summary: The government plans to issue 67 trillion won in public bonds during the third quarter, 4 trillion won more than originally planned, due to increased policy demand and somewhat recovering bond market conditions.

key_headlines.title: Naver, Nvidia, and Brookfield to Invest 10 Billion Dollars in Korean AI Infrastructure
key_headlines.summary: Major tech companies Naver, Nvidia, and Brookfield announced a strategic partnership to invest approximately 10 billion dollars in South Korea's AI infrastructure, targeting data centers, semiconductors, and energy sectors.

sections.Hot Economy News: The Korean economy faces fresh challenges as the Trump administration implements 12.5% forced labor tariffs affecting major export industries. Domestically, inflation concerns are mounting with the government taking measures to freeze oil prices and extend fuel tax reductions while expanding rent tax deductions to ease household financial burdens. Meanwhile, major corporations including Naver, SK, and Samsung are ramping up strategic investments in AI infrastructure partnerships with US tech giants like Nvidia and Microsoft, signaling confidence in long-term growth opportunities despite near-term market volatility.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The government is issuing 67 trillion won in public bonds during Q3, an increase of 4 trillion won from original plans, reflecting growing policy financing needs. The Bank of Korea's recent data shows a significant gap between real GDI and GDP growth, with semiconductor export gains not translating proportionally to domestic consumption and employment. Concerns about AI bubble burst and its potential impact on real economic activity have emerged globally, with Korea's economic trajectory entering a critical inflection point that could affect growth rates between 2-3% according to policy officials.
sections.Financial Markets: The domestic stock market experienced severe volatility with the Kospi plunging over 5% triggering multiple circuit breakers as geopolitical risks from the Middle East and rising oil prices fueled inflation concerns. Despite broader market weakness, individual stocks like SK Eternics surged significantly, with the stock gaining 25% in July alone as investors sought sector-specific opportunities in clean energy and infrastructure. The VKOSPI volatility index reached 80 levels, comparable to pandemic-era highs, prompting regulators to strengthen deposit requirements and tighten leverage trading rules to cool excessive speculation.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korea's major export sectors including semiconductors, automotive, and steel were exempted from forced labor tariffs, though other industries face new regulatory uncertainties. The nation is positioning itself to compete among the world's top three in AI while leveraging accumulated industrial data from automotive, shipbuilding, and battery sectors for manufacturing optimization and autonomous production advancement. China's CATL reported 42% profit growth in H1 despite electric vehicle battery market slowdown, driven by surging demand in energy storage systems, signaling industry shift toward new growth drivers.
sections.Real Estate: Monthly rental prices continue rising across the nation, prompting the government to expand tax deduction benefits for tenants in the upcoming tax reform. The presidential administration held a major real estate policy debate forum discussing redevelopment and reconstruction projects, with controversy over their actual supply effectiveness in the housing market. Seoul apartment transaction data shows a shift toward higher-priced properties above 900 million won due to mortgage loan limits, while prices continue climbing with the Kospi housing price index rising for 76 consecutive weeks.
sections.International Economy: The Trump administration's new forced labor tariff regime replaces earlier 10% global tariffs affecting South Korea, Japan, and other major trading partners, with Samsung and LG adjusting their global production strategies in response. Middle East geopolitical tensions are driving oil prices to record highs, creating spillover effects on global inflation expectations and prompting speculation about potential Federal Reserve rate increases. Japan expressed regret over the tariff measures, claiming its industrial and trade practices comply with international regulations, while South Korea is leveraging the Korea-US Shipbuilding Cooperation Center to strengthen bilateral cooperation in strategic sectors.
sections.AI & Economy: Naver, Nvidia, and Brookfield announced a 10 billion dollar investment partnership in Korean AI infrastructure, while SK is pursuing a 750 billion dollar AI infrastructure collaboration with major US tech companies including Nvidia and Microsoft. Naver is launching its AI Factory business to capture emerging opportunities in computing resource rental services as major technology companies face acute computational resource scarcity. The government is pursuing three mega-projects in semiconductors, AI data centers, and physical AI, positioning South Korea as a critical hub in the global AI ecosystem with both domestic companies and international partners investing heavily.
sections.Others: The government is actively engaging with US political and business leaders to address trade frictions and resolve disputes related to Coupang and other commercial issues, with officials meeting key congressional members and senators. Regulators have accelerated implementation of tighter trading rules, raising deposit requirements for leveraged single-stock ETFs and ETNs on Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix to 30 million won starting July 31. President Lee Jae-myung is conducting a US and Central/South America tour to promote AI investment expansion and cooperation, meeting with Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and other industry leaders to explore partnership opportunities.
